config.intro: Blocks the Escape (back) key sent after a right-click.
config.enabled.name: Enable mod
config.enabled.tooltip: Turn the whole mod on or off without uninstalling it.
config.block-escape.name: Block Escape key
config.block-escape.tooltip: Suppress the Escape key entirely. Menus must be closed with the on-screen X button.
config.extra-buttons.name: Extra blocked buttons
config.extra-buttons.tooltip: Additional buttons to suppress. Useful if your device maps the back button to something else.
config.toggle-key.name: Toggle mod key
config.toggle-key.tooltip: Press this to enable or disable the mod while playing.
config.grace-ticks.name: Suppress grace ticks
config.grace-ticks.tooltip: How many extra ticks to keep swallowing input after a blocked press. Raise this if menus still close. 60 ticks = 1 second.
config.debug-log.name: Debug: log buttons
config.debug-log.tooltip: Write every button press to the SMAPI console. Useful for checking what is sent when right-click is released.
